messages:
elaine: Heads-up: we got 3 fresh tickets around SDK import shape + edge usage. I did a quick triage; looks like a mix of default-export vs named-export confusion + TS resolution when using bundlers. Can we quickly align on a publish shape that minimizes support overhead?

mik: TL;DR: dual artifacts (cjs + esm) + explicit exports map. Also make sure we don't ship `__esModule` shims consumers can accidentally rely on.

nate: Noted a weird one: user on Bun complained `import Redwood from 'redwood'` gave undefined; they had esModuleInterop off and were doing `import * as Redwood from 'redwood'` and expecting default. We should document recommended tsconfig flags or provide a stable named export.

priya: Wouldn't it be easier to always export a stable named export like `export const Redwood = ...` and `export default Redwood` in ESM build, and in CJS do `module.exports = exports.default = Redwood` so both forms work? Fewer surprises.

elaine: I like keeping a named export plus default. People who disable esModuleInterop still get `import { Redwood } from 'redwood'`. Sample code in README should show both patterns.

mik: About the package.json shape, suggestion:

```json
"main": "./cjs/index.js",
"module": "./esm/index.js",
"types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./esm/index.js",
    "require": "./cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

That covers Node >=12 + bundlers. Types top-level is needed for TS resolution.

nate: Also we found consumers on older rollup builds needed `sideEffects: false` and clear `module` field. Not all bundlers read `exports`. So we keep `module` as a helpful hint.

priya: Edge runtimes: Vercel edge and Cloudflare Workers require pure ESM. CI should include a smoke test that `import`-loads the esm build in an ESM-only runner (we can use bun or a node --experimental-modules job).

build-bot: CI job proposed: matrix [node-12-require, node-18-import, bun-edge-import]. Will run: `node -e "require('./cjs/index.js')"`, `node --input-type=module -e "import('./esm/index.js').then(()=>console.log('ok'))"`, and `bun --version && bun --no-check ./esm/index.js` smoke.

elaine: Also: typings. We should emit single `dist/index.d.ts` and ship `types` at package root pointing to it. For better DX add a tiny `types` import path in exports for modern TS: "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" inside exports condition. But don't rely on that alone.

mik: One compatibility gotcha: `exports` field blocks deep requires (like `require('redwood/some/internal')`) unless you explicitly export paths. We should avoid supporting internal paths, but support `./runtime` and `./fetch` if we plan to have separate entrypoints. If we don't, be explicit in exports so consumers get clear errors.

nate: Example for runtime-specific entrypoints (if we want):

```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./esm/index.js", "require": "./cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" },
  "./edge": { "import": "./esm/edge.js", "types": "./dist/edge.d.ts" },
  "./node": { "require": "./cjs/node.js", "import": "./esm/node.js" },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

priya: I think offering `./edge` and `./node` helps onboarding (examples/edge-app, examples/node-app). We should keep them small wrappers that re-export core. That reduces user confusion about which entry to import.

elaine: Support notes: update support KB to call out three things to try: 1) Try `import { Redwood } from 'redwood'` vs default import. 2) Toggle `esModuleInterop` or `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` if TS errors. 3) In bundlers, prefer the `module` or `exports` resolution; upgrade webpack to >=5 if possible.

support-bot: Created KB draft: "SDK import troubleshooting" and added links to examples/node-app and examples/edge-app.

mik: Final ask: Lee and build team to add postpack script that verifies package tarball `npm pack` contains cjs/esm/types + correct exports. Sam can add unit tests for default vs named import interop using dynamic runner.

elaine: OK action list: mik to add export policy in PR template; nate to add examples and small edge wrapper; priya to update README + KB; build-bot will add CI matrix; support-bot will polish KB. We'll monitor Slack for new tickets after publish. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
